# Precision Optical Metronome
> High-precision web metronome supporting arbitrary float BPM, sub-millisecond accuracy, and optical visual flash.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-millisecond timing precision powered by the Web Audio API hardware audio clock.
- Supports arbitrary floating-point BPM inputs (e.g., 96.05 BPM) for precise tempo adjustment and video/audio synchronization.
- High-contrast visual optical screen flash synchronized precisely with audio cues and display refresh rates.
- Online Demo: https://defei-wang.github.io/precision-metronome/
